versions.changelog: 0.1.2: SKILL.md 移除 disable:true，恢复 AI 自动触发能力。

- Initial release of "qianwen-cdp": native Chrome DevTools Protocol driver for Qianwen browser.
- Enables robust office automation by reusing real user login state and opening/controlling new browser tabs.
- Solves incompatibility with xbrowser/agent-browser: only native CDP with self-created targets works reliably in Qianwen.
- Provides command-line utilities for open, navigation, JS eval, content extraction, click, type, screenshot, etc.
- Installation and environment variable configuration guidance included; supports persistent Qianwen instances.
- Key limitations, troubleshooting notes, and end-to-end automation capabilities clearly documented.
